[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Resplendent Makuun | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=402 }} [[Resplendent Makuun]] houses the extravagant palace of [[Prince Bokka the Magnificent]]. One can find many nobles, artists, and performers within the palace grounds. It was first established and ruled by [[Amaki Voss]], the first nominal "prince" of Vabbi. ==Getting there== This area lies to the southeast of [[the Mirror of Lyss]], past [[Honur Hill]]. Characters are most likely to venture here for the first time as part of the [[primary quest]] [[All's Well That Ends Well]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: *[[Vabbian Scout]] → [[Monster Hunt]] **At the exit to [[Honur Hill]]. **Inside Prince Bokka's palace, opposite the hanging fountains. **Outside the south wall of palace. *Vabbian Scout → [[Skree Battle]] **At the exit to [[Yahnur Market]]. **East of Yahnur Market, midway along the southern edge. *[[Whispers Informant]] → [[Elemental Hunt]] **Along the eastern edge, east of the palace, near [[Nuwisha]]. **At the exit into the [[Wilderness of Bahdza]]. **Outside the northern edge of the palace. ;Resurrection shrines with a [[statue]]: *[[Avatar of Dwayna (NPC)|Avatar of Dwayna]] **At the exit into the Wilderness of Bahdza. **Outside the south wall of palace. *[[Champion of Balthazar]] **Outside the northern edge of the palace. *[[Lyssa's Muse]] **At the exit to Honur Hill. **At the exit to Yahnur Market. **Inside Prince Bokka's palace, opposite the hanging fountains. *[[Melandru's Watcher]] **East of Yahnur Market, midway along the southern edge. *[[Voice of Grenth]] **Along the eastern edge, east of the palace, near Nuwisha. ==Quests available== *[[Goren]] **[[Goren's Stuff: Part 1]] *[[Norgu]] **[[The Role of a Lifetime]] *[[Prince Bokka the Magnificent]] **[[Worst.
